name: Follow explicit GEO study publications
description: Retrieve PubMed summaries for publication identifiers explicitly listed in a returned GEO DataSets record.
planner_guidance: The citations action follows only publication IDs explicitly listed in a returned GDS record.
Prefer following those explicit study-publication links when relevant to the question.

arguments.name: record_id
arguments.description: A returned GEO DataSets record identifier.

limitations: A listed publication describes a study; it is not independent validation of that study.

policy_constraints.attribution: Cite the GEO record field that lists each publication.
